workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: Upon completion of the 2011-2012 school year, the duty year shall automatically revert to 185 days pursuant to the configuration set forth in the 2007-2010 negotiated agreement, unless agreed to otherwise by the parties in a new negotiated agreement.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: 8 hours (480 minutes) work day; 7.0 hours (420 minutes) duty day
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: 1.1 Work Day: Unit members shall have a work day of 8 hours (480 minutes) in which to perform their on-site and off-site professional responsibilities. / 1.2 Duty Day: Unit members are required to be on duty at their worksites for 7.0 hours (420 minutes) per day which shall be utilized for student instruction.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: 2.2 All preparation time allocated within the 7 hours (420 minutes) as described in 1.2 shall be utilized for duties set forth above in 2.1.1 – 2.1.12 as determined by the teacher

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Secondary: 480 minutes per week (at least one 45-minute block daily); Elementary: 45-minute block daily on at least 156 days
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: 4.2 ...Teachers shall be provided 480 minutes per week for preparation time within the work day in blocks no shorter than thirty (30) minutes with at least one block of forty-five (45) minutes per day within the work day. / 5.2.2.1 The preparation time set forth herein shall be provided on at least 156 days out of the traditional 180 day schedule

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: 2.2 All preparation time allocated within the 7 hours (420 minutes) as described in 1.2 shall be utilized for duties set forth above in 2.1.1 – 2.1.12 as determined by the teacher

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: 1.4 Duty Free Lunch: Unit members shall have a duty free lunch of at least 30 minutes per day.
